section: Medical professional databases with language filters
text: These websites let you to find doctors by language. Doctolib – Filter by profession, area and language. You can book appointments online. Jameda – Filter by profession, area and language. You can book appointments online. Doctena – Filter by profession, area and language. You can book appointments online. aerzte-berlin.de – Filter by profession, area and language Kassenärztliche Vereinigung Berlin – Filter by profession, area and keyword. You can also find a doctor by phone; call 116117 Queermed – Queer-friendly doctors and therapists Ask your health insurance too. TK has a list of English-speaking doctors. They can even book an appointment for you.
